    When Ron Weasley was seven, Fred Weasley gave him an Acid Pop, calling it a Sugar Quill, and it burnt through his tongue.
  121. 1987
    Gryffindor win the Quidditch Cup with Charlie Weasley
    Gryffindor won the Quidditch Cup with Charlie Weasley as Seeker; he later captained the team and was still spoken of in the common room like a minor saint.
  122. 1987
    Warren Worthington becomes Death
    Apocalypse gave Warren Worthington, whose wings had been cut off, new wings of metal and made him Death, one of his Horsemen.
  123. 1987
    Gryffindor's last Quidditch CupB3 Ch15
    Gryffindor last won the Quidditch Cup about seven years before 1994, when Charlie Weasley was Seeker.
  124. 1987
    Justice League charterB4 Ch3
    The Justice League began working under a United Nations charter.
  125. September 1987
    Percy Weasley and Oliver Wood start at Hogwarts
    Percy Weasley and Oliver Wood entered Hogwarts and were sorted into Gryffindor, and Marcus Flint, later Slytherin's Quidditch captain, started in the same year; all three left in 1994.
  126. December 1987
    Harry Potter sees the window at St Michael's
    At Christmas when he was seven, Harry Potter was taken to St Michael's Church in Little Whinging, because Aunt Petunia would not be outdone by the Polkisses, and stared through the carols at the stained-glass window of Christ over the altar.
  127. December 1987
    Harry sees the face in the church window
    One Christmas when Harry Potter was seven, Petunia Dursley took the family to church because the Polkisses had started going; it was the only time Harry went inside a church as a child, and he saw a face in a window that he would see again.
  128. December 1987
    Harry taken to church at ChristmasB2 Ch19
    Aunt Petunia took seven-year-old Harry to church because the Polkisses went; he saw windows of Saint George and of a bearded man and an old woman crossing herself.
  129. December 1987
    Harry's first visit to St Michael'sB3 Ch22
    At seven, one Christmas, Harry sat in St Michael's beside Dudley and stared at the window of Christ throughout the service.
  130. 1988
    Zandi buys the land round the Cleft
    Elias Zandi began buying up the land round the tunnels and the Cleft, and after another expedition brought in Dr Richard Watson; the small group began to dig, quietly and on Zandi's money.
  131. 1988
    Venom is born
    The living black costume Spider-Man had brought home from Battleworld bonded with a man who hated him and became Venom.
  132. 1988
    The Dominators' gene bomb
    As the Alien Alliance withdrew late in 1988, the Dominators set off a gene bomb that attacked the metagene, and for a time nearly every superhuman whose powers came from it lost control of them or fell gravely ill until a remedy was found. The word metahuman came into common use.
  133. 1988
    Dream escapes his prison
    After seventy-two years Dream of the Endless escaped the glass prison in which Roderick Burgess had caught him.
  134. 1988
    Death walks Dream through her day
    Death found her brother Dream sulking in a park after his escape and walked him through a day of her work until he understood what he still had.
  135. 1988
    The Beyonder becomes Kosmos
    It was learnt that the Beyonder had been a living Cosmic Cube joined to part of the Molecule Man's power, and in that form he grew into a new cosmic being called Kosmos.
  136. 1988
    The Deltites take over S.H.I.E.L.D.
    Nick Fury found that S.H.I.E.L.D. and Hydra had both been taken over from within by the Deltites, the agency's own Life Model Decoys grown aware. Framed and hunted by his own people, he went underground, exposed and destroyed them, and disbanded S.H.I.E.L.D.
  137. c. 1988
    Neville shows his first magic
    Aged eight, Neville Longbottom bounced down the garden and into the road unharmed when his Great-uncle Algie accidentally dropped him from an upstairs window, ending his family's fear that he had no magic.
  138. 1988
    The Goa'uld refuse to join the Alien Alliance
    The Dominators invited the Goa'uld System Lords to join their Alliance against Earth. The System Lords refused without giving a reason, since the Goa'uld had been forbidden to speak of Earth since Ra's fall.
  139. Winter 1988
    The Horsemen of Apocalypse attack New York
    Apocalypse's Horsemen attacked New York. X-Factor beat them and took his ship.
  140. c. 1988
    Lucius moves the peacocksB3 Ch9
    When Dracina Malfoy was eight and afraid of the peacocks, her father went out on the lawn and moved them.
  141. c. 1988
    The frozen lake at Malfoy ManorB3 Ch12
    Lucius Malfoy had the lake at Malfoy Manor frozen for Dracina when she was eight, using a method from a book.
  142. 19 March 1988
    Loftin takes Elias Zandi down to D'ni
    John Loftin led the archaeologist Elias Zandi down into the tunnels, which led to the cavern of D'ni.
  143. 1989
    Thor merges with Eric Masterson
    Eric Masterson, a divorced New York architect who had first crossed Thor's path in 1988, was mortally injured in one of Thor's battles, and Thor merged with him to save his life, so that he could change into Thor and back.
  144. 1989
    S.H.I.E.L.D. is rebuilt
    Nick Fury rebuilt S.H.I.E.L.D. as a smaller agency, small enough for its Director to keep watch over.
  145. 1989
    Doom frees his mother's soul
    Victor von Doom's mother Cynthia, a Romani witch of Latveria, had given her soul to Mephisto for power and died when Victor was a child. In 1989 Doom and Stephen Strange went together into the demon's realm, and Doom at last set her free.
  146. 1989
    Mephisto unmakes the Vision's twins
    The twin sons of the Vision and the Scarlet Witch had been made in part from shards of Mephisto's own essence; he took the shards back, and the children were unmade.
  147. 1989
    Steve Rogers takes back the shield
    Rogers became Captain America again, and John Walker became the U.S. Agent.
  148. 1989
    Hydrobase sinks
    At the end of 1989 Hydrobase sank, and the Avengers returned to their rebuilt mansion on Fifth Avenue.
  149. 1989
    Justice League Europe opens in Paris
    A European branch of the Justice League opened in Paris, with Captain Atom, Power Girl, the Elongated Man, Animal Man, Metamorpho, Rocket Red and the Flash, Wally West, by then about forty.
  150. 1989
    Death raises Thanos
    At the end of 1989 Death raised Thanos from the dead to restore the balance between the living and the dead.
  151. c. 1989
    Dracina sees through Crabbe and Goyle
    By the age of nine Dracina Malfoy had worked out that Vincent Crabbe and Gregory Goyle reported everything she did to her father, and she began feeding them insults to report.
  152. c. 1989
    Bill Weasley joins Gringotts in Egypt
    Bill Weasley, a former Gryffindor prefect and Head Boy with twelve O.W.L.s, left Hogwarts and went to work for Gringotts as a curse-breaker on the pharaohs' tombs in Egypt.
  153. 1989
    Superman is given the Eradicator
    Far from Earth, Superman was given the Eradicator, an ancient Kryptonian device, by an old wanderer called the Cleric.
  154. 1989
    The second Kree-Skrull war ends
    The Skrull S'Byll restored her people's power to change shape and unmasked the impostor Nenora. The war ended in a ceasefire.
  155. c. 1989
    The twins take the Marauder's MapB3 Ch10
    In their first year Fred and George Weasley stole the Marauder's Map from a drawer in Filch's office marked 'Confiscated and Highly Dangerous'.
  156. September 1989
    Fred, George and Lee Jordan start at Hogwarts
    Fred and George Weasley, Lee Jordan, Angelina Johnson and Alicia Spinnet entered Hogwarts and were sorted into Gryffindor, while Cedric Diggory of the same intake went to Hufflepuff.
  157. c. 1990
    The Myst linking book is sold for fifty dollars
    A digger at the Cleft sold Atrus's Myst linking book for fifty dollars to Ephraim Shacklewell of Shacklewell House, who put it in a glass case in his trophy room and never touched it.
  158. 1990
    The Excalibur shuttle disaster
    The space shuttle Excalibur, commanded by Hank Henshaw, was struck by radiation in orbit. Henshaw's body broke down and his mind passed into machinery, his wife Terri died soon afterwards, and Henshaw, blaming Superman, left Earth in the Kryptonian birthing matrix that had once carried the infant Kal-El.
  159. 1990
    Lex Luthor stages his own death
    Dying of cancer caused by his Kryptonite ring, Lex Luthor was reported dead when his private jet crashed late in 1990. His brain had been placed in a young cloned body, and he reappeared as his own long-lost Australian son and heir, Lex Luthor II, and took over LexCorp.
  160. c. 1990
    Sersi joins the Avengers
    At the turn of 1990 Sersi, one of the immortal Eternals, joined the Avengers.
  161. 1990
    Spider-Man joins the Avengers' reserve
    Early in 1990 Spider-Man, then a man of about forty-three, became a reserve member of the Avengers.
  162. c. 1990
    Alicia Spinnet becomes reserve Chaser
    Alicia Spinnet served as a reserve Chaser for Gryffindor in the 1990 to 1991 season, the season before Harry Potter joined the team.
  163. 1990
    Fudge becomes Minister for Magic
    Cornelius Fudge succeeded Millicent Bagnold as Minister for Magic and at first relied heavily on Albus Dumbledore's advice.
  164. c. 1990
    Quirrell meets Voldemort in Albania
    Quirinus Quirrell, a Ravenclaw who had taught Muggle Studies at Hogwarts, took time away to travel and as a foolish young man met Lord Voldemort in the forests of Albania, who taught him that there is no good and evil, only power.
  165. 1990
    Darkseid and Thanos race for the Infinity Gems
    All through 1990 Darkseid and Thanos raced each other for the six Infinity Gems, then held by the Elders of the Universe. Thanos won every race.
  166. 1990
    Cable arrives from the future
    The soldier Cable, Nathan Summers grown old in a future century, came back to the present.
  167. 1990
    Hagrid buys FluffyB1 Ch7
    Hagrid bought the three-headed dog Fluffy from a man he met in a pub.
  168. c. 1990
    Ripper chases Harry up a treeB3 Ch2
    On Marge's last visit before Hogwarts, Ripper kept Harry up a tree until past midnight.
  169. September 1990
    Katie Bell and Cho Chang start at Hogwarts
    Katie Bell entered Hogwarts and was sorted into Gryffindor, and Cho Chang was sorted into Ravenclaw, where she became the house Seeker.
  170. 1991
    John Loftin dies in the cavern
    John Loftin died during one of the expeditions into the cavern of D'ni.
  171. 1991
    Constantine cheats the three lords of Hell
    Dying of lung cancer, John Constantine sold his soul separately to the Second and the Third of the Fallen and cut his wrists. When the First of the Fallen, the Devil, came to collect, the other two arrived to claim their purchase, and rather than fight a war in Hell the First cured his cancer and let him live.
  172. 1991
    The Infinity Gauntlet
    Thanos gathered all six Infinity Gems in a single gauntlet and, to prove his devotion to Death, erased half of all living things with a gesture. His granddaughter Nebula seized the gauntlet and undid the day, so that almost nobody remembers it, and Death still would not have him.
  173. 1991
    Kent and Inza Nelson return to life
    Kent and Inza Nelson came back to life in younger bodies, and Inza took up the work of Doctor Fate.
  174. 1991
    Wonder Woman fights Circe
    In a conflict among the gods that spilt across the Earth, Wonder Woman fought the sorceress Circe.
  175. 1991
    The Hulk's personalities are merged
    Bruce Banner's personalities were merged into a single Hulk.
  176. 1991
    Xavier returns to Earth
    Charles Xavier came back to Earth after his years with the Shi'ar.
  177. c. 1991
    Magneto gathers the Acolytes
    By 1991 Magneto had broken with the X-Men again and was gathering a band of devoted followers, the Acolytes.
  178. 1991
    The X-Men split into two squads
    The X-Men had grown so large that the team split into two squads.
  179. 1991
    Freedom Force breaks up
    Freedom Force broke up after a disastrous mission in Kuwait during the Gulf War, and since then the Mutant Registration Act has been enforced only fitfully.
  180. 1991
    S.H.I.E.L.D. takes a new name
    S.H.I.E.L.D. took a new name to fit the old initials, the Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate.
  181. c. 1991
    Graydon Creed founds the Friends of Humanity
    In the early 1990s the political organiser Graydon Creed, secretly the abandoned son of the mutants Mystique and Sabretooth, built up the Friends of Humanity, which campaigned against mutants in public while some of its cells turned to terror.
  182. 1991
    The Justice League breaks apart
    In 1991 and 1992 a run of disasters shook the League: Maxwell Lord fell into a coma, Despero rampaged through New York, members were killed or walked out, and the United Nations withdrew its support for a time.
  183. 1991
    Odin banishes Thor
    Late in 1991 Odin banished Thor, and Eric Masterson was given Thor's form, strength and hammer to serve in his place, as Thor, among the Avengers.
  184. c. 1991
    The Avengers take a United Nations charter
    As the Cold War ended, the Avengers' American charter was given up under a treaty between Washington and Moscow, and the team took a charter from the United Nations instead, the accord under which it still operates.
  185. 1991
    Harry talks to the boa constrictor
    At the zoo, before he knew he was a wizard, Harry Potter spoke to a boa constrictor without knowing it was Parseltongue and accidentally set it on Dudley Dursley.
  186. 1991
    Percy is made a prefect
    Percy Weasley was made a Gryffindor prefect; his parents bought him the screech owl Hermes, named after the messenger of the Greek gods, and his old rat Scabbers passed to Ron.
  187. c. 1991
    Charlie Weasley goes to Romania
    After leaving Hogwarts Charlie Weasley went to Romania to study and keep dragons.
  188. 1991
    Vernon nails up the letter box
    When Harry Potter's Hogwarts letters began to arrive at Number Four, Privet Drive, Vernon Dursley nailed planks across the letter box and swore when they came down the chimney.
  189. c. 1991
    Yeesha gives Catherine's journals to the Miller brothers
    About 1991 Yeesha, the daughter of Atrus, gave her mother Catherine's journals to the brothers Rand and Robyn Miller of Cyan. From them the brothers made Myst and the games that followed it. It was Yeesha's plan: the games were meant to draw people of D'ni blood to the Cleft and the caverns of D'ni.
  190. 1991
    Thanos turns Darkseid to glass
    When Thanos wiped out half of all living things with the Infinity Gauntlet, Darkseid came in person to fight him beside the cosmic powers and Earth's heroes. Thanos turned him into a statue of glass. The day was undone, but Darkseid remembers it.
  191. 1991
    Apocalypse infects Nathan Summers
    Apocalypse infected Cyclops's small son Nathan with a techno-organic virus. Askani took the boy into the future to be cured.
  192. 1991
    Crystal joins the Avengers
    Crystal of the Inhumans joined the Avengers.
  193. 1991
    Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn seize the Kree Empire
    The Kree generals Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn seized power in the Kree Empire.
  194. 1991
    The Warskrull plot
    Warskrulls had taken the places of Charles Xavier and others. The X-Men freed Xavier, and Deathbird let Lilandra keep the throne.
  195. 1991
    Slytherin win the Quidditch finalB1 Ch5
    Slytherin flattened Gryffindor in the final Quidditch match of the 1990 to 1991 season.
  196. 1991
    Charlie's tentacled idolB1 Ch13
    Charlie Weasley sent Percy an idol from Romania that Mrs Weasley confiscated.
  197. 1991
    The enchanted tea set incidentB2 Ch3
    An enchanted tea set sold to a Muggle came alive and sang; its owner died of shock and Arthur Weasley and Perkins used Memory Charms to cover it up.

Wolverine nearly gutted Magneto, who tore the adamantium out of his skeleton, and Charles Xavier ended the battle by shutting down Magneto's mind and leaving him in a coma.     Colonel Jack O'Neill led a team through the Stargate to Abydos with the archaeologist Daniel Jackson, and there they overthrew the Goa'uld Ra. O'Neill learnt that the Goa'uld exist.

    Early in 1994 the Egyptologist Daniel Jackson lectured that the Great Pyramid had not been built by the pharaohs of the Fourth Dynasty; much of his audience walked out and his funding was withdrawn, and Catherine Langford recruited him to translate the Giza cover stones for the United States Air Force.

    The American professor and cave explorer Dr Richard Watson, one of the few who had not laughed at Daniel Jackson, was working in New Mexico on the D'ni cavern, a project he would not discuss.
  75. c. 1994

    Shortly before the Abydos mission Charlie, son of Jack and Sara O'Neill, shot himself by accident with his father's pistol; O'Neill blamed himself, his marriage broke and he retired from the Air Force until it called him back.
  76. c. 1994

    In the year after the fall of New Delhi most of the other genetically engineered rulers were overthrown by their own people, and the rest swore allegiance to Khan Noonien Singh or were destroyed by him.
  77. c. 1994

    Rita Repulsa drained Tommy Oliver's powers with a cursed green candle; what Zordon could give back was not permanent, and by the summer of 1994 the Green Ranger's powers kept running out.
  78. 1994

    With Ra dead above Abydos, the System Lords were left without a Supreme System Lord, and Apophis moved fastest to take over Ra's domains.
  79. 1994

    Scott Summers and Jean Grey were carried two thousand years into the future, where they spent twelve years raising the boy Nathan before coming back to the moment they had left.

    In the spring of 1994 the Molecule Man drew the Beyonder out of Kosmos again, and the struggle between them threatened every universe at once.

    Hagrid threw Walden Macnair into the pumpkin patch after Macnair insulted his giant mother.
  138. 6 June 1994
    Confrontation in the Shrieking ShackB3 Ch18
    Sirius Black dragged Ron under the Whomping Willow; in the Shrieking Shack, Lupin and Black revealed Scabbers to be Peter Pettigrew, and Harry, Ron and Hermione knocked out Snape.
  139. 6 June 1994
    Lupin transforms on the lawnB3 Ch19
    Without his Wolfsbane Potion, Lupin transformed into a Garou under the full moon and hunted Harry, while Peter Pettigrew escaped as a rat.
  140. 6 June 1994
    Buckbeak rescued at sundownB3 Ch20
    As Walden Macnair's axe fell at the appointed execution, Dracina Malfoy lured Buckbeak loose with a dead ferret and flew him away into the Forbidden Forest.
  141. 6 June 1994
    Dementors at the lakeB3 Ch20
    About a hundred dementors closed on Sirius, Harry and Hermione at the lake and were driven off by a stag Patronus cast by the time-travelling Harry, while an arrow of white light destroyed the last.
  142. 6 June 1994
    Lupin restored in the ForestB3 Ch20
    Kneeling in a Forest stream to shield Dracina Malfoy, Harry cast a Shield Charm that turned white and forced the werewolf back into Remus Lupin's human shape.
  143. 6 June 1994
    Time-Turner usedB3 Ch20
    At five minutes to midnight Dumbledore locked Harry and Hermione in the hospital wing, and Hermione turned her Time-Turner three times to take them back three hours.
  144. 6 June 1994
    Linking to Myst IslandB3 Ch20
    Shortly before midnight, Harry, Hermione and Dracina reached Flitwick's office on Buckbeak, found Sirius gone and the Myst book on the desk, and linked to Myst Island as the Aurors opened the door.
  145. Summer 1994
    Major Force kills Alexandra DeWitt
    In the summer of 1994 the soldier and murderer Major Force, looking for Green Lantern, killed Kyle Rayner's girlfriend, Alexandra DeWitt, in his flat.
  146. July 1994
    Zero Hour: time begins to fail
    In July 1994 time broke down across the world. Districts of cities slipped into other years, people met the dead and their own younger selves, and a wave of nothingness rolled back from the end of time, erasing the far future age by age.
  147. July 1994
    Extant breaks the Justice Society
    At Vanishing Point, beyond the end of time, the time-mad Extant took back the years the Justice Society had been spared since the war. The Atom (Al Pratt), Hourman (Rex Tyler) and Doctor Mid-Nite (Charles McNider) died; the rest were aged in moments to their true years, and Kent and Inza Nelson were torn from the power of Fate.
  148. July 1994
    Harry finishes The Lord of the RingsB3 Ch22
    Harry finished The Lord of the Rings by streetlamp the night before his first Evensong.
  149. July 1994
    Harry's first Evensong at St Michael'sB3 Ch22
    On a Sunday evening at the beginning of July Harry went into St Michael's for the first time, found the vicar was the old man from the lych-gate, and heard a sermon on holy anger.
  150. c. 1994
    Hermione's Myst letterB4 Ch2
    About a fortnight after Harry got home, Hermione wrote that the computer game Myst showed their island and told the story of Atrus.
  151. July 1994
    Moonlight on Harry's bookB4 Ch2
    At the end of July, when Harry's lamp bulb failed, moonlight lit his book exactly until he finished the chapter.
  152. July 1994
    Augments appear in the former YugoslaviaB4 Ch3
    Augment forces led by Joaquin appeared in the Balkans and in five weeks took Kosovo, the Montenegrin coast and most of eastern Bosnia.
  153. July 1994
    United Nations suspends the Justice League charterB4 Ch3
    The UN suspended the charter under which the Justice League had worked since 1987.
  154. 31 July 1994
    Harry's fourteenth birthdayB4 Ch2
    Hedwig brought Hermione's card and a book at four minutes past midnight, Juniper brought Dracina's letter, and cakes came from Ron, Hermione, Hagrid and Sirius; the Dursleys ignored the day.

Book Four: 1994 to 1995

  1. August 1994
    Parallax is stopped at the beginning of time
    Hal Jordan, the lost Green Lantern, now calling himself Parallax, was revealed as the power behind Zero Hour, trying to remake history so that Coast City had never fallen. The heroes stopped him, and Connor Hawke, son of the first Green Arrow, shot him through the heart; he survived and vanished again.
  2. August 1994
    Time begins again
    Early in August 1994 the young hero Damage released the energy of a new beginning at the dawn of all things, and time was started again from it. History came back very nearly as it had been, and most people remember the weeks of Zero Hour only as a strange dream.
  3. August 1994
    The Justice Society disbands
    After Zero Hour the surviving members of the Justice Society, old now in body as well as in years, agreed that the Society's day was done, and disbanded it.
  4. August 1994
    Daniel Jackson declared deadB4 Ch3
    The Egyptologist Daniel Jackson, twenty-nine, was declared dead after a shaft collapsed beneath the Giza plateau.
  5. August 1994
    Senate hearing on the Sentinel programmeB4 Ch3
    The Senate Armed Services Committee was to hear evidence on reviving the Sentinels against Khan.
  6. c. 1994
    Death of Manfred WörnerB4 Ch3
    Nato's Secretary-General Manfred Wörner died the weekend before 20 August 1994, and an acting Secretary-General took over.
  7. 18 August 1994
    Bleeding rats in the Dursleys' fridgeB4 Ch2
    On Thursday morning Aunt Petunia found the fridge crammed with bleeding rats; Harry suspected Sirius.
  8. 18 August 1994
    The Prime Minister returns from holidayB4 Ch3
    The British Prime Minister returned early from his holiday because of the Augment War.
  9. 19 August 1994
    Superman addresses the Security CouncilB4 Ch3
    Superman asked the UN Security Council to let the Justice League and the Avengers act against the Augments; the Council adjourned without a vote.
  10. 20 August 1994
    Harry's dream of the house on the hillB4 Ch1
    Harry dreamt of murdering his father and grandparents in a house on a hill and of Dracina turning into a snake, and woke with his scar burning.
  11. 20 August 1994
    Harry writes to Sirius about his scarB4 Ch2
    At dawn Harry wrote to Sirius that his scar had hurt, leaving out the dream.
  12. 20 August 1994
    Protest outside the United NationsB4 Ch3
    More than twenty thousand people protested against superhumans outside the United Nations overnight, chanting 'No more capes!'
  13. 20 August 1994
    Mud from the Dursleys' plugholeB4 Ch3
    Pond mud erupted from the Dursleys' kitchen plughole, and Vernon gave Harry Molly Weasley's letter inviting him to the World Cup final.
  14. 20 August 1994
    Augment forces near BelgradeB4 Ch3
    The news reported Augment forces within forty miles of Belgrade after the collapse of the rump Yugoslav army.
  15. 20 August 1994
    Pig brings Ron's letterB4 Ch3
    Pig brought Ron's letter about the World Cup tickets; Harry replied and sent Hedwig to Sirius.
  16. 21 August 1994
    The Weasleys to collect HarryB4 Ch3
    The Weasleys planned to fetch Harry from Privet Drive at five o'clock on Sunday.
  17. 22 August 1994
    Quidditch World Cup finalB4 Ch3
    The 1994 Quidditch World Cup final, Ireland against Bulgaria, was set for Monday night.
  18. 23 August 1994
    Security Council to meet againB4 Ch3
    The UN Security Council was due to meet again on Tuesday, and the protest was to continue until then.
  19. 1995
    The fall of Outer Heaven
    Learning that Outer Heaven, Big Boss's fortified mercenary state in southern Africa, had built the walking nuclear weapon Metal Gear, FOXHOUND sent in Gray Fox, who was captured, and then the rookie Solid Snake alone, who destroyed Metal Gear and brought down Venom Snake at its head.
  20. 1995
    Apocalypse returns
    Apocalypse came back from the Moon, where he had been left for dead.

Book 5: 1995 to 1996

  1. 1996
    John Mason helps retake Alcatraz
    John Mason was brought out of Wolfburg to guide a naval team into Alcatraz, which renegade Marines had seized with rockets of poison gas aimed at San Francisco.
  2. 1996
    Buffy Summers is called as the Slayer
    Buffy Summers, a fifteen-year-old Los Angeles schoolgirl, was called as the Slayer and trained by the Watcher Merrick. After he was killed and she burned down her school gymnasium full of vampires, her parents' marriage broke up.
  3. 1996
    Whistler shows Angel the Slayer
    A demon named Whistler found Angel starving in the streets of New York and showed him the newly called Slayer, Buffy Summers.
  4. c. 1996
    A Prague mob nearly destroys Drusilla
    Shortly before 1997 a mob in Prague nearly destroyed Drusilla, leaving her weakened.
  5. 1996
    Elias Zandi dies
    Elias Zandi died of a massive heart attack, leaving his fortune to the restoration of D'ni with Richard Watson as sole chairman, and his land round the Cleft to his estranged son, Jeff.
  6. 1996
    Bond retakes Alcatraz
    When renegade Marines under General Francis Hummel seized Alcatraz and threatened San Francisco with rockets of VX gas, James Bond was brought out of Wolfburg as the only man who had ever escaped the island, to take a team back in.

Book 6: 1996 to 1997

  1. 1997
    Riven released
    The game Riven was released.
  2. 1997
    Buffy Summers moves to Sunnydale
    Buffy and her mother moved to Sunnydale, California, a town built over a Hellmouth, where her new Watcher, Rupert Giles, worked as the school librarian.
  3. 1997
    Angel goes to Sunnydale
    Angel went to Sunnydale to help Buffy, and fought beside her against the Master's followers and his own former companions.
  4. 1997
    Jenny Calendar watches Angel for the Kalderash
    Janna of the Kalderash, living as the computer teacher Jenny Calendar, was in Sunnydale on her clan's orders to watch Angel, and her uncle Enyos came to hold her to the task.
  5. 1997
    Spike brings Drusilla to Sunnydale
    William the Bloody brought the weakened Drusilla to Sunnydale, where he met Angel again.
  6. 1997
    The D'ni Restoration Council is founded
    Richard Watson founded the D'ni Restoration Council with Dr Ikuro Kodama, Victor Laxman and Dr Marie Sutherland to survey the city, make it safe, restore its machinery and record what it found.
  7. 1997
    The Goa'uld return through the Stargate
    Apophis, who had been taking over Ra's domains since Ra's death and had heard that Thor was busy elsewhere, broke Ra's ban on Earth and came through the Stargate. His Jaffa killed the soldiers guarding it and carried one off. On Abydos he took Sha'uri and Skaara as hosts. The programme was reopened with teams sent out to other worlds; Jack O'Neill was recalled to command SG-1, and Daniel Jackson returned to Earth.
  8. 1997
    Zanzibar Land declares independence
    Zanzibar Land in Central Asia rose against the Commonwealth of Independent States, beat back its armies with mercenaries gathered from all over the world and declared itself an independent military state with Big Boss behind it.
  9. 1997
    Teal'c turns against Apophis
    Teal'c, Bra'tac's best pupil and his successor as First Prime of Apophis, turned against his master and joined SG-1, and Bra'tac became one of Earth's closest allies and a leader of the free Jaffa.
  10. 1997
    Darla is destroyed in Sunnydale
    Serving the imprisoned Master in Sunnydale, Darla was staked by Angel as she tried to kill the Slayer Buffy Summers.
  11. 1997
    Thor's Hammer destroyed
    On Cimmeria the device called Thor's Hammer seized the Jaffa Teal'c for the larva he carried, and SG-1 destroyed it to free him.
  12. 1997
    Nirrti wipes out Hanka
    To hide her breeding of a perfect host, Nirrti killed the people of Hanka with a plague. Only Cassandra survived.
  13. 1997
    The Supreme Intelligence returns
    The Supreme Intelligence, believed dead since the Avengers executed it in 1992, was found to have survived.
  14. Spring 1997
    Buffy Summers destroys the Master
    In the spring the Master fed on Buffy and left her to drown, and her brief death freed him; revived the same night, she destroyed him, and later ground his bones to powder when his followers tried to raise him.

Book 7: 1997 to 1998

  1. Autumn 1997
    Drusilla is restored with her sire's blood
    Late in the year Drusilla was restored to strength in Sunnydale with the blood of her own sire, Angel.
  2. 1998
    Angelus kills Jenny Calendar and Enyos
    After the curse broke, Angelus killed Janna, the Kalderash woman known as Jenny Calendar, and her uncle Enyos; her translation of the ritual survived her.
  3. 1998
    Buffy sends Angel into a hell dimension
    Buffy Summers was forced to send Angel into a hell dimension.
  4. 1998
    Apophis's motherships destroyed above Earth
    Apophis and Klorel brought two motherships against Earth. SG-1 and Bra'tac destroyed both. Apophis and Klorel escaped through the Stargate on board.
  5. 1998
    Heru'ur driven from Cimmeria again
    Heru'ur invaded Cimmeria after Thor's Hammer fell. Asgard answered, and he escaped through the gate, leaving his army behind.
  6. 19 January 1998
    Angel's curse breaks
    On Buffy's seventeenth birthday Angel knew a moment of true happiness with her, the Kalderash curse broke, and Angelus returned and turned on everyone who had trusted Angel.
  7. Spring 1998
    Willow Rosenberg restores Angel's soul
    In the spring the witch Willow Rosenberg used Jenny Calendar's translation to restore the Kalderash curse.

After the saga

  1. 1999
    Solid Snake defeats Big Boss at Zanzibar Land
    During a world oil crisis Zanzibar Land kidnapped the Czech biologist Dr Kio Marv; FOXHOUND under Colonel Roy Campbell sent Solid Snake in alone, and he destroyed Metal Gear D, fought Gray Fox in a minefield and defeated the real Big Boss.
  2. 1999
    The Demon Castle War destroys Dracula for good
    When Dracula's castle rose for the last time, Julius Belmont, with Alucard beside him, destroyed Dracula so completely that he could not return, and the castle was sealed inside a solar eclipse. Julius lost his memory in the struggle.
  3. 1999
    Angel sets up as a detective in Los Angeles
    Angel moved to Los Angeles and set up as a private detective, helping those who came to him in trouble.
  4. 1999
    Spike is implanted with a chip
    A secret military project in Sunnydale implanted a device in William the Bloody's head that stopped him from harming people.
  5. 1999
    Michael Engberg joins the D'ni Restoration Council
    Michael Engberg joined the D'ni Restoration Council.
  6. 1999
    The Society of Leopold wakes Christof
    The Society of Leopold excavated Vyšehrad and carried Christof Romuald to London, where he woke after more than eight hundred years.
  7. 1999
    Christof destroys Vukodlak
    In the Cathedral of Flesh in New York Christof Romuald destroyed the Tzimisce Methuselah Vukodlak, and Embraced Anezka, the nun he had loved in Prague, so that she would not die.
  8. 1999
    Sokar demands Apophis from Earth
    Sokar fired a beam through the wormhole at Earth's iris until the body of Apophis, who had died at the base, was sent to him.
  9. 1999
    Earth is added to the Protected Planets Treaty
    Thor himself opened talks on Earth with Cronus, Nirrti and Lord Yu. Nirrti's attempt to wreck them failed, and Earth was put under the treaty.
  10. 1999
    The destruction of Netu
    A Tok'ra bomb destroyed Sokar's prison moon and his ship, killing Sokar. Apophis escaped and took over his forces.
  11. 2000
    The monks make the Key into Dawn Summers
    When the hell-god Glory came hunting the Key, the last of the monks who guarded it made it into a living girl of about fourteen, Dawn, sent to Buffy Summers as her sister, and altered everyone's memories so that she seemed always to have been there.
  12. 2000
    Wolfram and Hart raise Darla
    The Los Angeles law firm Wolfram and Hart raised Darla as a mortal woman dying once more of her old disease, and Drusilla sired her again.
  13. c. 2000
    George Sears reaches the presidency
    By the start of the new century Solidus Snake, under the name George Sears, had risen in Washington as far as the presidency of the United States.
  14. 2000
    Death of Heru'ur
    Apophis lured Heru'ur to the Tobin minefield to talk of an alliance, destroyed his ship with a cloaked fleet and took his forces.
  15. 2001
    Myst III released
    Myst III was released.
  16. 2001
    Glory opens the way with Dawn's blood
    Glory used Dawn Summers's blood to open the way between worlds.
  17. 2001
    Buffy Summers dies to save Dawn
    Buffy, who shared her sister's blood, closed the way between worlds by dying in Dawn's place, and was brought back.
  18. 2001
    Daniel Holtz wakes in Los Angeles
    Daniel Holtz woke from his long sleep in Los Angeles to find Angelus become Angel, and still meant to have his revenge.
  19. 2001
    Darla dies giving birth to Connor
    Darla bore Angel's son Connor in an alley in Los Angeles and died to give him life.
  20. 2001
    Death of Cronus
    On Juna, Cronus was shot by a machine copy of Teal'c, and SG-1 took his mothership.
  21. 2001
    Death of Apophis
    Flung into another galaxy by the supernova at Vorash, Apophis lost his ship to the Replicators. The ship he took from SG-1 fell on Delmak with him aboard.
  22. 2002
    Spike wins back a soul
    William the Bloody went to Africa and won back a soul.
  23. 2002
    The System Lords take Anubis back
    Seven System Lords met under truce in the Hasara system. Osiris came for Anubis, and all but Yu voted to take him back. Daniel Jackson, there to poison them for the Tok'ra, held back.
  24. 2002
    Anubis takes Thor prisoner
    Over Adara II Anubis, half-ascended through the Devil's trick, captured Thor and tried to read his mind. Thor turned the link against him, and SG-1 freed him.
  25. 2002
    Svarog's attack on Latona
    Svarog invaded Latona. The Sentinel, restarted when Grieves of the NID joined himself to it, swept his Jaffa away.
  26. 2003
    Uru released
    Uru was released.
  27. 2003
    Sunnydale is destroyed
    Buffy Summers led the fight in which the town of Sunnydale collapsed into the ground over its Hellmouth and was destroyed; Dawn stayed with her sister afterwards.
  28. 2003
    Spike dies saving the world
    William the Bloody died to save the world when Sunnydale was destroyed, though he did not stay dead.
  29. 2003
    Anubis destroys Abydos
    With the six Eyes of the Goa'uld, Anubis destroyed the System Lords' fleet, then Abydos.
  30. 2003
    Death of Nirrti
    Wodan, one of the people she had experimented on, broke Nirrti's neck.
  31. 2004
    Myst IV released
    Myst IV was released.
  32. 2004
    Death of Moloc
    Missiles sent through the Stargate from Earth killed Moloc. Ba'al took his domain.
  33. 2004
    The System Lords' embassy to Earth
    Camulus, Amaterasu and Yu came to Stargate Command to ask for help against Ba'al. Camulus stayed behind and asked for asylum.
  34. 2004
    Camulus handed to Ba'al
    After Ba'al falsely claimed to hold SG-1, Earth sent Camulus to him carrying a dead power source.
  35. 2005
    Myst V released
    Myst V was released.
  36. 2005
    The Shadow Moses incident
    Renegade FOXHOUND under Liquid Snake seized the nuclear disposal facility on Shadow Moses Island, Alaska, with Metal Gear REX; Solid Snake, brought out of retirement by Roy Campbell, destroyed REX with Hal Emmerich's help, learned from Liquid that they were twin clones of Big Boss, and Liquid died.
  37. 2005
    Death of Lord Yu
    A Replicator in Samantha Carter's likeness killed Yu at the Hasara space station.
  38. 2005
    Oma Desala takes Anubis
    As Anubis prepared to fire the weapon on Dakara, Oma Desala drew him into a struggle without end.
  39. 2005
    Ba'al's war on the System Lords
    The Tok'ra reported that Bastet and Olokun were dead and Morrigan had surrendered, while Yu and Amaterasu gathered for a last stand.
  40. 2005
    The Ori are found
    Daniel Jackson and Vala Mal Doran found the galaxy of the Ori, using a device of the Ancients. Soon afterwards the Ori's Priors began coming through the Stargates into this one.
  41. 2006
    A Prior's plague reaches Earth
    A plague spread by one of the Ori's Priors reached Earth, and a cure was found only just in time.
  42. 2006
    Birth of Adria
    Adria, the Orici, was born to Vala Mal Doran by the power of the Ori alone, with no father, and grew to a woman in a matter of days.
  43. 2006
    The Ori fleet comes through
    The Priors opened a great gate, large enough for warships. The Ori's fleet came through it, broke the ships of Earth and the free Jaffa, and began its crusade.
  44. 2007
    Solid Snake and the tanker on the Hudson
    Solid Snake slipped aboard a tanker on the Hudson River to photograph a new Metal Gear, RAY, carried in its hold. The tanker was sunk, and Snake was believed to have died with it.
  45. 2007
    The Ori are cast down
    A weapon made long ago by one of the Ancients broke the power of the Ori and drove them out into the outer darkness with Melkor. Adria rose to a higher plane and took up what was left of their power.
  46. 2008
    The last clone of Ba'al
    The Tok'ra extracted the last of Ba'al's clones on their homeworld.
  47. 2008
    The Ark of Truth
    The Ark of Truth, a device of the Ancients, was turned on the Doci at Celestis, and the followers of Origin saw that the Ori were no gods. Ganos Lal took Adria out of the world into a struggle without end.
  48. 2009
    The Big Shell incident
    Solidus Snake, raised in public life as George Sears, led the Sons of Liberty in seizing the Big Shell, an offshore clean-up facility in New York Bay, and was killed in Manhattan at the end of the incident.
  49. 2014
    Old Snake's last mission
    Solid Snake, aged far before his time, went on a last mission against Liquid Ocelot and brought down the Patriots' hidden control of the world's wars.
  50. 2014
    Solid Snake's last mission
    Solid Snake undertook his last mission, the year in which Big Boss's story also ended.
  51. 2035
    Soma Cruz is drawn into Dracula's castle
    At the first solar eclipse of the century, Soma Cruz, an eighteen-year-old exchange student in Japan and Dracula reborn, was drawn into the sealed castle with Mina Hakuba. There he met Genya Arikado, who was Alucard, and the memoryless J, who was Julius Belmont and regained his memory, and Soma refused the Dark Lord's inheritance.
  52. 2036
    Soma Cruz defeats the cult of Celia
    A year later the cult of Celia Fortner tried to make Soma Cruz into the new dark lord. He defeated them and refused Dracula's inheritance a second time.
  53. 2036
    Soma Cruz refuses Celia Fortner's cult
    A cult led by Celia Fortner tried to force the Dark Lord awake in Soma Cruz, and he refused again, helped by Alucard and by Julius Belmont, who had joined the Belnades witch Yoko Belnades in the Church's work against the cult.
  54. c. 29,800
    The Emperor of Mankind unites Terra
    At the end of the Age of Strife Conan, coming first as Revelation, united the warring peoples of Terra as the Emperor of Mankind, founded the Imperium of Man and began the Great Crusade.
  55. c. 30,014
    The Emperor is set upon the Golden Throne
    After the Siege of Terra, in which he cast down his rebel son Horus and was wounded past healing, the Emperor of Mankind was set upon the Golden Throne, where he has sat ever since, worshipped as the God-Emperor.

An encyclopaedia of the series

The Malfoid Saga

The story of Harry Potter and the girl who noticed him. Every character, place, spell and secret is here, with a timeline from the Elder Days to the books still to come.

Read the Malfoid SagaEvery book, free to read online at malfoid.lol

Here be spoilers

This wiki covers every book published so far, up to the latest chapters of Book Four, and it holds nothing back. It includes secrets, true identities and history the books themselves have not revealed yet. If you have not caught up, read with care.

A work in progress

The saga is still being written, and so is this wiki. Every page is subject to additions, edits and changes as new chapters arrive.

Recommended reading

The pages that matter most for understanding the saga.

About the saga

The Malfoid Saga retells the Harry Potter story with one great change: the Malfoy heir is a girl, Dracina Malfoy, silver-blonde and silver-eyed, who noticed Harry before anybody else did. Around them the world is wider and stranger than the wizards know. Middle-earth, Narnia and the D’ni were real. Superheroes, genetically engineered warlords and alien gods share the Muggle century. Faith in God is as true as any spell.

The Malfoid Saga is free, unofficial, non-profit fan fiction. This wiki is not affiliated with the creators or owners of Harry Potter.
